name: Frosthowl

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know how hard it is to fish Dun Morogh’s frozen lakes through biting cold. Wendigo attacks threaten local fishers and their livelihoods.
As an Alliance adventurer, you help keep the icy paths and fishing spots near Brewnall and Kharanos safe from aggressive predators.

faq.answer: Frosthowl is an aggressive wendigo in Dun Morogh. Its roars frighten fish on the frozen lake. The beast recently attacked a dwarven fisher and stole the catch she and her husband had spent days gathering.
Frosthowl hides deep within the Grizzled Den, southeast of the frozen lake where Paxton fishes.
Frosthowl stole a sack of fish that Paxton and his wife spent days catching on the frozen lake. The fisher asks travelers to confront the beast and recover their catch.
Paxton is a dwarven fisherman who spent days fishing on the frozen lake. His wife asks passing travelers to track Frosthowl after it stole their sack of fish.

aliases: where do wendigos live in dun morogh
faq.answer: The Grizzled Den is a wendigo lair southeast of the frozen lake in Dun Morogh. Frosthowl fled into its tunnels after stealing the fishers’ catch.

aliases: how did frosthowl get its name
faq.answer: Frosthowl is called a loudmouth for its thunderous roars and howls across the snowy plains. The noise threatens to frighten fish away and troubles those working on the frozen lakes.
faq.q: Why is the beast named Frosthowl?

sections.body: A dwarven fisher and her husband, Paxton, spent days fishing on Dun Morogh’s frozen lake. Through biting winds, they gathered a single sack of fish to bring home. Then Frosthowl ambushed their camp and carried off the catch into the snowy wilderness.
sections.title: A Stolen Haul

sections.body: Frosthowl’s booming roars rattle the ice and frighten the lake’s sparse fish. After stealing the fisher’s sack, the beast fled deep into the Grizzled Den, southeast of the lake. Now the fishers are stranded without their catch. They need someone to confront Frosthowl and recover the stolen fish.
sections.title: The Loudmouth of the Grizzled Den

summary: In Dun Morogh, Frosthowl's attack leaves a dwarven fisher without her catch. The wendigo fled into the Grizzled Den with the sack of fish.
